=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1358-1457 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_resolver_test_repair_context` sets `INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE` as a shell variable but never exports it, and it is missing from the env prefix of the python3 renderer (lines 1453-1457). The renderer reads `os.environ.get('INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE','')`, gets an empty path, and puts `{}` in place of `{{INTENT_FINGERPRINTS_JSON}}`.
  WHY: The only code that exports the variable is `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:1363` (via GITHUB_ENV), and that runs only on the conflict path, which this mode skips. So the repair model never sees the merged sub-issue fingerprints, while the hard gate at line 1532 still enforces them and reverts repairs (`outcome=repair_reverted reason=fingerprints`). The unit test misses this because it stubs `_resolver_test_repair_context`. Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; gemini gave no severity.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4421-5341 (lines 4507, 4618, 4660, 4685, 5341) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `rb_judge` (line 4419-4421) now skips when `env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE == 'true'`, but the review-blocked exhaustion steps that read its outputs have no such gate. Its outputs are therefore empty, and `'' != 'true'` evaluates true. The steps are: "Mark linked issues review-blocked" (4507), "Mark outage-caused review-blocked labels" (4618), "Force orchestrate poll" (4660), "Post review-blocked comment" (4685) and "Telegram review-blocked judge decision" (5341).
  WHY: On an orch_final PR with `max_iterations_reached=true`, a repair-only dispatch labels the linked issues `ai:review-blocked`, posts a review-blocked comment, forces an orchestrate poll and sends a judge Telegram message with no judge result. That parks the final PR even though nothing was reviewed. Reviewers disagree on 4618: anthropic and minimax include it; anthropic says it cannot fire and should be gated only for consistency; z-ai says it is safe and openai leaves it out. The fix count also differs: test count 21→26 (anthropic) vs 21→25 (z-ai). Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; gemini gave no severity.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5037 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Telegram success" step lacks `env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true'`, which the last run added to its sibling steps "Enable auto-merge on PR" (4312) and "Mark linked issues ready to merge" (4342).
  WHY: On a repair-only run "Commit changes" is skipped, so `did_commit != 'true'` holds, and a "PR processed" notification goes out for a run that reviewed nothing. This only reaches consumers who opted in through `PR_PROCESSED_ALERT_LEVEL`. Three reviewers rated it NIT; gemini gave no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Growth is at most 1,000 bytes" for `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (issue #8210, §Changes item 4)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, the "Integration post-sync test repair" step and its added `if:` clauses
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `agents.d/8210-prepush-gate-integration-repair.md:32` records 3,228 bytes of growth, and the last-run diff adds more `if:` clauses (security pass + rb_judge). gemini and minimax call this an accepted, documented won't-fix, recorded in the agents.d and changelog.d fragments. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash deliberately did not raise it, calling it an accepted deferral with the file well under the 480,000-byte guard.
- requirement: `internal-review.yml` pass-through is added only in a form that does not break runs on this PR, or the follow-up is recorded in the agents.d fragment (issue #8210, §Changes item 1)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/internal-review.yml` and `agents.d/8210-prepush-gate-integration-repair.md` "Known gaps" section
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The agents.d "Known gaps" section records the follow-up, citing the PR #4438 startup_failure because `review_autofix.yml@main` lacks the `post_sync_test_repair` input. Both reviewers call it an explicit deferral that meets the issue's fallback. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash deliberately did not raise it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4507, 4618, 4660, 4685, 5341 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The last run gated rb_judge (line 4419) on `env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true'`, but the five exhaustion fallback steps did not get the clause. When rb_judge is skipped, `judge_handled` is empty, `'' != 'true'` is true, and the steps run. Line 4618 also needs `rb_judge_provider_unavailable == 'true'`, so it cannot fire; the clause there is only for consistency.
  WHY: `scripts/review_autofix_step_count_iterations.sh:121-130,177-179` sets `max_iterations_reached=true` once the commit count hits the limit, which orchestrator final PRs often do. "Integration post-sync test repair" (line 3349) does not check retrigger_guard. A repair dispatch therefore labels linked issues review-blocked, posts a comment, forces a poll and sends a Telegram message with no judge result, on every new integration head. Fix: add the clause to all five `if:` lines and raise the test count from 21 to 26, and update the agents.d and changelog step lists.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1358-1359, 1453-1457 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE` is assigned without `export`, and the env prefix on lines 1453-1457 leaves it out. The only exporter is `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:1363` (GITHUB_ENV), and it runs only on the conflict path.
  WHY: The renderer replaces `{{INTENT_FINGERPRINTS_JSON}}` with `{}`, while the gate at line 1532 reads the real file, so repairs that touch fingerprinted lines are reverted (`outcome=repair_reverted reason=fingerprints`). The test hides this with a stub. Fix: add `INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE="${INTEGRATION_FINGERPRINTS_FILE:-}"` to the prefix at line 1453, or `export` it at line 1358.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5037 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The "Telegram success" `if:` lacks `env.INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE != 'true'`, unlike its siblings at lines 4312 and 4342.
  WHY: On a repair-only run, `did_commit != 'true'` holds, so a "PR processed" notification is sent. It only reaches users who raised the alert level.
- TASK_GAP: NONE. The 1,000-byte growth limit (actual 3,228 bytes) and the `internal-review.yml` pass-through were deliberately not re-raised: both are documented won't-fix / deferrals in agents.d "Known gaps".
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items): gate lines 4507/4618/4660/4685/5341 and raise the test count 21→26 (about 6 lines); add the fingerprint env prefix at review_conflict_resolve.sh line 1453 (1 line); gate "Telegram success" at line 5037 (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
